scripts.deploy:sandbox: npm run build:web && wrangler deploy --env sandbox
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:web && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.writes:resume:sandbox: wrangler d1 execute ebay-autopilot-sandbox --env sandbox --remote --command "UPDATE settings SET value = '0' WHERE key = 'writes_paused'"
scripts.writes:resume:production: wrangler d1 execute ebay-autopilot-production --env production --remote --command "UPDATE settings SET value = '0' WHERE key = 'writes_paused'"
